lines.en: That was a metaphor, in case you still haven’t picked up on my affinity for those yet.
lines.zh: 那是个比喻——万一你到现在还没发现我对比喻的热爱。

lines.en: Today, it isn’t raining at all.
lines.zh: 今天,根本没有下雨。

lines.en: To splash is to exist. And the puddles are air-pockets I don’t belong in as my true home is the ocean.
lines.zh: 拍打水花即是存在。而水洼是我并不属于的气穴——因为我真正的家在海洋。

lines.en: This amphibious shell makes breathing on land possible, but I know where it is I really belong.
lines.zh: 这具两栖的躯壳让在陆地上呼吸成为可能,但我知道自己真正属于哪里。

lines.en: Somewhere far away from here — filled with people I can relate to about things I care about.
lines.zh: 一个离这里很远的某个地方——住着能和我聊我在乎之事的人们。

lines.en: But instead, my air-pocket today is the backseat of a car I’ve found myself in before.
lines.zh: 但今天,我的气穴是某辆车的后座——一个我以前待过的地方。

lines.en: The two girls joining me here, while they may look similar to the last one, are not the same.
lines.zh: 此刻和我同座的两个女孩,虽然可能和上一位长得像,却不是同一个人。

lines.en: And I cannot relate to either of them at all, for they were not born with skin as permeable as mine.
lines.zh: 而我对她们俩完全无法共情,因为她们生来就没有我这样可渗透的皮肤。

lines.en: They can not survive in the water, and puddles like this are seen as nothing more than things to play in.
lines.zh: 她们无法在水中存活,而这样的水洼,在她们眼里不过是玩耍的地方。

lines.en: So as this external lung unsuccessfully siphons the bad out of the good and takes it all in as one singular dose of half-tainted oxygen, I wish I was born with fur.
lines.zh: 于是,当这只外置的肺徒劳地把坏的从好的里滤出来、把一切都当作一剂半污染的氧气吸进去时,我真希望自己生来有毛皮。

lines.en: That way, I wouldn’t have to deal with any of this.
lines.zh: 那样的话,我就不必应付这一切。

lines.en: And I could touch anything I wanted without fear of contamination.
lines.zh: 我也可以碰任何我想碰的东西,而不怕被污染。

lines.en: : You look kind of weird, Jeeves. Weirder than normal, I mean- since you look pretty weird in general.
lines.zh: : 你看起来有点怪,Jeeves。比平时还怪——我是说,你本来就显得挺怪的。

lines.en: : Tsukasa is right. You seem a tad bit “out of your element” right now. Could it be that Chika’s nostalgic tales have cast a shadow on you the same way they did me?
lines.zh: : Tsukasa 说得对。你现在似乎有点「离开了本行」。难道 Chika 的怀旧故事,也像影响我那样,在你身上投下了阴影?

lines.en: : Yeah, that has to be it. There’s no way being in the back of a car with two girls from the wealthiest family in all of Kumon-mi would take me “out of my element.” This is clearly where I belong.
lines.zh: : 对,肯定是那样。和 Kumon-mi 最富家族的两个女孩坐在轿车后座,才不会让我「离开本行」。这里显然就是我的归宿。

lines.en: : Is commoner sarcasm always so snarky and unfunny? Or are you just bad at making jokes?
lines.zh: : 平民的讽刺总是这么刻薄又不好笑吗?还是你就是不会讲笑话?

lines.en: : Tsukasa, be nice. We may not be at the manor, but Sensei is still our guest. And we must treat him with the same level of respect we’d treat anyone else.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa,要有礼貌。我们虽然不在公馆,但 Sensei 仍是我们的客人。我们必须以对待其他任何人的同等敬意对待他。

lines.en: : Yes, Mother. Can I ask a question, though?
lines.zh: : 是,母亲。不过我能问个问题吗?

lines.en: : Of course, dear.
lines.zh: : 当然,亲爱的。

lines.en: : Why do we have to drive him home when he said he was okay with walking? Isn’t doing that just unnecessarily flaunting how rich we are?
lines.zh: : 明明说了走路就行,为什么还要开车送他回家?这么做不就是在不必要地炫耀我们多有钱吗?

lines.en: : There is a difference between doing something to flaunt one’s wealth and doing something out of the kindness of one’s heart.
lines.zh: : 炫耀财富而行事,与出于善心而行事,是有区别的。

lines.en: : If you’d like a better explanation, look no further than your older sister as the two of you seem to approach this matter in completely different ways.
lines.zh: : 如果你想要更好的解释,看看你姐姐就行——毕竟你们俩处理这件事的方式截然不同。

lines.en: : My way is better. People are always taking advantage of Onee-sama because she has a heart. Do you think Jeff Bezos or Elon Musk have hearts, Mother? Because I don’t. And they rule the world.
lines.zh: : 我的做法更好。人们总在利用 Onee-sama,因为她有颗心。你觉得 Jeff Bezos 或 Elon Musk 有心吗,母亲?我觉得没有。而他们统治着世界。

lines.en: : Well, until you rule the world, please try and be more like your sister.
lines.zh: : 那么在你统治世界之前,请尽量学学你姐姐。

lines.en: : Tsukasa’s right, though.
lines.zh: : 不过 Tsukasa 说得对。

lines.en: : I am?
lines.zh: : 我说得对?

lines.en: : Not about the wealth thing — though, I will agree you’re not entirely wrong in that regard. But I was talking more about the “driving me home” part.
lines.zh: : 不是有钱那部分——虽然在那方面你也不算全错。我说的是「送我回家」那部分。

lines.en: : You didn’t have to go this far out of your way for me, even if it was out of the kindness of your heart.
lines.zh: : 你本不必为我绕这么大远路,哪怕那是出于善心。

lines.en: : Nonsense. It’s no trouble at all. In fact, I’m glad things worked out this way as it gives me a rare opportunity to capitalize on something I’ve been particularly interested in.
lines.zh: : 胡说。一点也不麻烦。事实上,我很高兴事情这样发展,因为这给了我一个难得的机会,去利用一件我特别感兴趣的事。

lines.en: : There’s my mother. I knew you wouldn’t have gone through this much trouble if you didn’t have something to gain from it.
lines.zh: : 这才是我母亲。我就知道,若没有利可图,你不会费这么大周折。

lines.en: : So, what I’m hearing is that this is less “giving me a ride home” and more “kidnapping me to get something you want.”
lines.zh: : 那么,照我听到的意思,这与其说是「送我回家」,不如说是「绑架我以得到你想要的」。

lines.en: : Well, if you’d like to make me sound like some sort of villain, I suppose there would be a bit of truth to that.
lines.zh: : 嗯,如果你非要把我形容成某种反派,我想这话也有一点道理。

lines.en: : Well, what can I give you that your money can’t?
lines.zh: : 那么,我能给你什么你的钱买不到的东西呢?

lines.en: : Oh, and if it’s something you can’t say in front of Tsukasa for reasons, just wink at me. I will understand.
lines.zh: : 哦,还有——若出于某些原因,这件事不能当着 Tsukasa 的面说,就朝我眨眨眼。我会懂的。

lines.en: : Mother, what did that mean? Jeeves is trying to speak cryptically, but isn’t smart enough to do it properly so it didn’t make much sense to me.
lines.zh: : 母亲,那是什么意思?Jeeves 在试图打哑谜,但他不够聪明,打得不好,所以我没听懂。

lines.en: : Nothing, Tsukasa. And that is most assuredly not what I have “kidnapped” Sensei for.
lines.zh: : 没什么,Tsukasa。而且我「绑架」Sensei,也绝对不是为了那个。

lines.en: : I simply wanted to see the property my oldest daughter invested in. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是想看看大女儿投资的那处房产。仅此而已。

lines.en: : Joining the world of real estate is a very respectable decision to make at Touka’s age. Even if that decision was only partially made with her future in mind and not someone else’s.
lines.zh: : 在 Touka 这个年纪踏入房地产行业,是非常值得尊敬的决定。哪怕那个决定,只有一部分是为她的未来着想,而不是为别人的。

lines.en: : Well, ignoring the fact that I thought we were on the way to my actual home, it’s not like I pressured Touka into that or anything. I straight up told her I wouldn’t accept it.
lines.zh: : 嗯,撇开我以为我们在回我真正的家这一点,又不是我逼 Touka 买什么的。我明明白白告诉她我不会接受。

lines.en: : And yet you did accept it. Curious.
lines.zh: : 而你还是接受了。有意思。

lines.en: : She wouldn’t take no for an answer.
lines.zh: : 她不接受拒绝。

lines.en: : Touka rarely takes no for an answer. Do you cave to all of these assertions, or just the ones that greatly benefit you?
lines.zh: : Touka 很少接受拒绝。这些断言你全都屈服,还是只屈服那些大大有利于你的?

lines.en: : Why do you look so threatened? Did I hit the nail on the head?
lines.zh: : 你怎么一副被威胁的样子?我说中要害了?

lines.en: : Kind of. But if I look threatened, it’s probably more due to the fact that I know you could murder me and cover it up without any trouble at all.
lines.zh: : 算是。但如果我看起来被威胁,那多半更是因为我知道,你要杀我灭口毫无难度。

lines.en: : Nonsense. There would be a little bit of trouble. But I can promise you that you’re in good hands.
lines.zh: : 胡说。还是会有一点麻烦的。但我可以向你保证,你在可靠的人手里。

lines.en: : Touka would be quite disappointed if her favorite teacher mysteriously vanished, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然,若她最爱的老师神秘消失,Touka 会非常失望的。

lines.en: : So, what then? You just want to see my apartment and then you’ll release me from your villainous clutches?
lines.zh: : 那么,然后呢?你只是想看看我的公寓,然后就把我从你的魔爪中释放?

lines.en: : You think you can break free from my grasp that easily?
lines.zh: : 你以为你那么容易就能挣脱我的掌握?

lines.en: : No. And I also think I probably look slightly more threatened right now.
lines.zh: : 不能。而且我也觉得,我现在看起来被威胁得更明显了。

lines.en: : I think you should look slightly more threatened right now. I’m a very powerful woman, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我认为你现在就该显得被威胁得更明显。我可是位非常有权势的女性,Sensei。

lines.en: : Mother, is this what “flirting” is?
lines.zh: : 母亲,这就是「调情」吗?

lines.en: : What? Where did you learn that?
lines.zh: : 什么?你从哪学的这个词?

lines.en: : Jeeves, there are easier ways of getting inside Tsukioka Manor than engaging in an affair with my mother. You don’t have to try that hard. The butler offer is still on the table.
lines.zh: : Jeeves,想进 Tsukioka 公馆有的是更简单的办法,犯不着和我母亲偷情。你不必这么拼。管家一职的邀约依然有效。

lines.en: : Tsukasa, that is absolutely not what is going on right now. It was playful bantering. Right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Tsukasa,现在完全不是那么回事。那是玩闹式的斗嘴。对吧,Sensei?

lines.en: : It kind of felt like flirting near the end there. I won’t lie.
lines.zh: : 到最后确实有点像调情。我不撒谎。

lines.en: : Ugh, fantastic. Now, Tsukasa’s curiosity is going to be piqued and we’ll need to start her on “those” slideshows even earlier than anticipated. And she was already ahead of schedule.
lines.zh: : 唉,好极了。这下 Tsukasa 的好奇心要被勾起来了,我们得比预计更早让她开始看「那些」幻灯片了。而她本来就已经超前了。

lines.en: : Do I have to watch those? Onee-sama didn’t leave her wing of the manor for a full week after she watched them and that makes me kind of worried.
lines.zh: : 我必须看那些吗?Onee-sama 看完之后整整一周没离开过她那侧翼房,这让我有点担心。

lines.en: : I will not argue if you also wind up staying in your wing for a week after all is said and done. Or longer.
lines.zh: : 要是一切结束后,你也在侧翼房里待上一周,我不会争辩。或者更久。

lines.en: : You two can look around the apartment. I doubt it will be any fun, though. I haven’t really changed anything yet.
lines.zh: : 你们俩可以随便参观公寓。虽然我觉得不会有什么乐趣。我还没怎么改动过。

lines.en: : Oh, Tsukasa won’t be joining us. It will just be you and me.
lines.zh: : 哦,Tsukasa 不和我们一起去。只有你和我。

lines.en: : What?! Why?! I want to see Onee-sama’s low-income housing too! You know I love low-income housing!
lines.zh: : 什么?!为什么?!我也想看 Onee-sama 的低收入住房!你知道我最爱低收入住房了!

lines.en: : What I know is that you need to go to sleep or you’ll be grumpy for your classes in the morning.
lines.zh: : 我知道的是,你得去睡觉,不然明早上课你会脾气很坏。

lines.en: : I already know everything in those classes! I want to learn more about real estate so I can help you and Onee-sama next year!
lines.zh: : 那些课的内容我早就会了!我想多学点房地产,这样明年就能帮您和 Onee-sama 了!

lines.en: : No means no, Tsukasa.
lines.zh: : 不就是不,Tsukasa。

lines.en: : But Mother-
lines.zh: : 可是母亲——

lines.en: : No talking back. Responsibility first, leisure second. If you do well tomorrow, then we can return to your sister’s building. Tonight, you will go to sleep.
lines.zh: : 不许顶嘴。责任第一,玩乐第二。明天你表现好,我们再回你姐姐的楼。今晚,你去睡觉。

lines.en: : ...Fine. But only because I’m extremely mature and goal-oriented.
lines.zh: : ……好吧。但只因为我非常成熟、非常有目标感。

lines.en: : This all works for you, correct?
lines.zh: : 这些安排你都满意吧?

lines.en: : Does it even matter? You’re just going to talk me into it if I say no.
lines.zh: : 满意与否重要吗?我要说不要,你也会把我劝得同意。

lines.en: : See? I told you it was impossible to escape my grasp.
lines.zh: : 看?我说过,逃离我的掌握是不可能的。

lines.en: The driver stops by Tsukioka Manor and drops Tsukasa off, who is then promptly escorted inside by an unnecessarily large amount of bodyguards and staff members.
lines.zh: 司机在 Tsukioka 公馆前停车,放下 Tsukasa——她随即被多到不必要的一大群保镖和佣人护送进门。

lines.en: I’m not sure what would have happened within the thirty seconds it took for them to make it down the walkway, but I guess that doesn’t matter as it's now fading from my vision anyway.
lines.zh: 在他们走完那条步道的三十秒内会发生什么,我并不清楚。不过那大概也无所谓,反正它已经从我的视野中远去。

lines.en: When we eventually make it to my apartment, Tsubasa takes it upon herself to start traipsing around as if she owns the place. Which...I guess she kind of does.
lines.zh: 等我们终于到我的公寓,Tsubasa 自作主张地开始四处溜达,仿佛这地方是她家的。哪……呃,某种意义上,还真差不多是。

lines.en: But that doesn’t make it any less weird.
lines.zh: 但这丝毫没有减少怪异感。

lines.en: In fact, this whole situation is weird.
lines.zh: 实际上,整个局面都很怪。

lines.en: I get wanting to check out the building her daughter invested in, but that could have been done without me.
lines.zh: 想看看她女儿投资的楼,我理解。但这本可以不带我来做。

lines.en: There are plenty of other rooms without tenants here. So either there’s more to this than she’s letting on or-
lines.zh: 这里还有好多没有租客的房间。所以要么事情不止她说的那些,要么——

lines.en: : I assume you’ve caught on by now that this is a little more than a quick walkthrough to inspect the property.
lines.zh: : 我想你现在已经明白,这不止是快速走一圈查查房产。

lines.en: : ...Yeah.
: I should have figured that out when you wouldn’t let Tsukasa come.
lines.zh: : 你不许 Tsukasa 来的时候,我就该想明白的。

lines.en: : Oh?
: Then, since you appear to have slipped into detective-mode, tell me...what do you think I was trying to gain by coming here alone with you in the middle of the night?
lines.zh: : 那么,既然你似乎切入了侦探模式,告诉我……你觉得,半夜和你单独来这里,我想得到什么?

lines.en: : Well?
lines.zh: : 怎么样?

lines.en: : I mean...common sense would probably say sex.
lines.zh: : 就是说……常识大概会说,性。

lines.en: : Is that your final answer?
lines.zh: : 这就是你的最终答案?

lines.en: : It would make the most sense.
lines.zh: : 那是最合理的。

lines.en: : You’re a seemingly...dissatisfied married woman with enough power and money to ensure I wouldn’t talk about it. Which I wouldn’t do anyway, but still.
lines.zh: : 你是一位看似……不满足的已婚女性,有权有钱,足以保证我不会外传。我也本来不会说,但还是。

lines.en: : And you’re certainly calculating enough to ensure we wouldn’t get caught.
lines.zh: : 而且你精于算计,足以保证我们不会被抓包。

lines.en: : But?
lines.zh: : 但是?

lines.en: : But...I feel like that’s not it.
lines.zh: : 但是……我觉得不是那样。

lines.en: : Then what is?
lines.zh: : 那是什么?

lines.en: : Something...with Chika? Or Touka?
lines.zh: : 某件……和 Chika 有关的事?或者 Touka?

lines.en: : Are you just guessing at this point?
lines.zh: : 你现在是在瞎猜吗?

lines.en: : Kind of, yeah.
lines.zh: : 算是,对。

lines.en: : Hmm...
: Do you have any champagne? Or wine?
lines.zh: : 你有香槟吗?或者红酒?

lines.en: : I...do not.
lines.zh: : 我……没有。

lines.en: : I suppose I’ll have to get you some as a housewarming present, then. It’s bad manners to keep your house-guests thirsty, you know.
lines.zh: : 那我想我得买一些,当你的乔迁礼。让客人干坐着口渴,可是失礼的,你知道吗。

lines.en: : I mean...it’s not like I was expecting-
lines.zh: : 就是说……我又没指望——

lines.en: : It’s bad manners to not offer them a seat as well.
lines.zh: : 不给客人让座,同样失礼。

lines.en: : Would you...like to sit?
lines.zh: : 你要……坐吗?

lines.en: : I thought you’d never ask.
lines.zh: : 我还以为你永远不开口了呢。

lines.en: Tsubasa steps forward and...takes a seat on the bed?
lines.zh: Tsubasa 走上前……坐到了床上?

lines.en: Is she actually here for sex after all?
lines.zh: 她终究是为性而来的?

lines.en: : Hmm...the decor is a bit bland for my tastes. But overall, I’d say this is an acceptable staging for Touka’s first property.
lines.zh: : 嗯……装修对我的口味来说有点寡淡。但总体而言,作为 Touka 的第一处房产,这样的布置可以接受。

lines.en: : You really lucked out getting this for free, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 免费得到这里,你真是撞了大运,对吧?

lines.en: : Like I said, I wasn’t asking for this.
lines.zh: : 就像我说的,这又不是我讨来的。

lines.en: : How many people know about this place?
lines.zh: : 有多少人知道这个地方?

lines.en: : Counting you? About...a handful.
lines.zh: : 算上你?大概……一小撮。

lines.en: There could have been more, but the world took them away.
lines.zh: 本来可以更多的,但世界把他们带走了。

lines.en: : So...three others apart from my daughter and me.
lines.zh: : 那么……除我女儿和我之外,还有三个人。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我懂了。

lines.en: : Is your niece one of them?
lines.zh: : 你侄女是其中之一吗?

lines.en: : She’s not.
lines.zh: : 她不是。

lines.en: : Is Chika one of them?
lines.zh: : Chika 是其中之一吗?

lines.en: : She’s...not.
lines.zh: : 她……不是。

lines.en: : Interesting.
lines.zh: : 有意思。

lines.en: : May I ask what you intend to use it for? You already have a house of your own. And, from what I understand, it’s your niece who takes care of you, so...
lines.zh: : 能问问你打算用它做什么吗?你已经有一栋自己的房子了。而且据我所知,照顾你的是你侄女,所以……

lines.en: : You’re likely not intending to live here, correct?
lines.zh: : 你多半不打算住在这里,对吧?

lines.en: : I don’t really have any idea what I’m going to use this place for just yet.
lines.zh: : 我其实还没想好这里要用来做什么。

lines.en: : Are you open to suggestions?
lines.zh: : 你接受建议吗?

lines.en: : I...guess?
lines.zh: : 我……猜接受?

lines.en: : Do you have something in mind?
lines.zh: : 你心里有想法了吗?

lines.en: : To begin, I think this would be an acceptable substitution for Touka’s bedroom the next time you engage in violent sex with a teenage girl.
lines.zh: : 首先,我觉得下次你和某个少女激烈性爱时,这里可以是一个 Touka 卧室的合格替代品。

lines.en: : Yeah...that’s a pretty reasonable suggestion. I’ll keep it in mind.
lines.zh: : 嗯……这个建议相当合理。我记下了。

lines.en: : Was the barking your idea or hers?
lines.zh: : 学狗叫是你的主意,还是她的?

lines.en: : Are you actually interested or are you just winding up to something?
lines.zh: : 你是真感兴趣,还是在酝酿什么?

lines.en: : Can it not be both?
lines.zh: : 不能两个都是吗?

lines.en: : I take it that means it’s both.
lines.zh: : 我想,那就是两个都是的意思。

lines.en: : I am a woman of questionable morals at times.
lines.zh: : 我是个时而道德存疑的女人。

lines.en: : Would I act as you do and go out of my way to engage in illicit relations with high schoolers? No. More than likely, not.
lines.zh: : 我会像你那样、主动去和高中生发生不正当关系吗?不会。多半不会。

lines.en: : But would I leave the door cracked and peer through as you do that for several minutes while questioning my sanity? Perhaps.
lines.zh: : 但我会不会把门虚掩着,从门缝里窥视你们那样做好几分钟、同时怀疑自己的理智?也许。

lines.en: : Did you enjoy the show?
lines.zh: : 那场演出还看得尽兴吗?

lines.en: : I enjoyed that you two enjoyed it. You seemed just as enthralled with one another as the day I first met you.
lines.zh: : 尽兴的是你们尽兴。你们看起来和初见那天一样,彼此痴迷。

lines.en: : Whether it be her body alone, the taboo nature of taking something you’re not allowed to have, or genuine love...I know not. But we’ve already discussed this once before and I don’t mean to do it again.
lines.zh: : 是只贪恋她的身体,还是僭越禁果的禁忌感,还是真爱……我不知道。但这我们以前已经聊过一次,我不打算再来一次。

lines.en: : Then...what do you intend to-
lines.zh: : 那么……你到底打算——

lines.en: : Why not share in this newfound convenience with someone who needs it more?
lines.zh: : 何不与某个更需要它的人,分享这份新到手的便利?

lines.en: : Why not ask Chika and her sister if they’d like to move in?
lines.zh: : 为什么不问问 Chika 和她妹妹,愿不愿意搬来住?

lines.en: : That’s a lot more wholesome of a suggestion than I expected based on your...demeanor ever since we left her apartment.
lines.zh: : 这个建议比我预想的纯良多了——鉴于自从离开她家后,你的……举止。

lines.en: : If I don’t keep you on your toes, you might wind up getting the better of me someday. And we can’t have that, can we?
lines.zh: : 我要是不让你时刻保持警惕,说不定哪天你就会反将我一军。那可不行,对吧?

lines.en: : Doesn’t matter. Chika already said no to your hospitality. And sure, you were inviting her to come live in your mansion, but I doubt she would have accepted this either.
lines.zh: : 无所谓。Chika 已经拒绝过你的好意了。是的,你请她去住的是你的公馆,但我怀疑这个她也不会接受。

lines.en: : As do I. Her will is far stronger than it should be for a girl her age. And her experience growing up with close to nothing has skewed her perception of just how meaningless material goods are.
lines.zh: : 我也一样。以她这个年纪的女孩来说,她的意志强得过分。她从小近乎一无所有的成长经历,已经扭曲了她对「物质多么无意义」的感知。

lines.en: : Says the woman with more “material goods” than anyone.
lines.zh: : 这话出自一个「物质」比谁都多的女人之口。

lines.en: : It’s because I have everything that I know just how little any of it matters.
lines.zh: : 正因为我拥有一切,我才知道这一切多么无足轻重。

lines.en: : I’ll never actually replace her mother. Nor do I intend to. And even if Chika appreciates the role I’ve somehow wound up with in her life, I think she feels a little guilty.
lines.zh: : 我永远不会真正取代她的母亲。我也不打算。就算 Chika 珍视我在她人生中不知不觉扮演的角色,我想她心里还是有点愧疚。

lines.en: : If I were her and the last connection I had with my mother apart from some jewelry and makeup were the memories of a home...and some other woman tried to whisk me away from that-
lines.zh: : 如果我是她——除了几件首饰和化妆品、与母亲最后的联结就是那间老屋的回忆——而另一个女人想把我从那里连根带走——

lines.en: : I’d almost surely say no as well.
lines.zh: : 我几乎肯定也会拒绝。

lines.en: : But that’s different from a person she’s in love with asking her. You wouldn’t be “replacing” anyone.
lines.zh: : 但那和一个她爱的人来问是两回事。你不会「取代」任何人。

lines.en: : You’d be the next step in her life...or a chance for her to grow without convincing herself she’s abandoned what little she has left.
lines.zh: : 你会只是她人生的下一步……或一个让她成长的机会,而不必说服自己,她抛弃了自己仅剩的一切。

lines.en: : But it wouldn’t be the right step.
lines.zh: : 但那不会是正确的一步。

lines.en: : Not even if it would make her safe?
lines.zh: : 哪怕那会让她更安全也不行?

lines.en: : You know very well she’s not safe with me.
lines.zh: : 你我都很清楚,跟着我,她并不安全。

lines.en: : Because you’re having consensual sex with her slightly before you’re supposed to be? That’s silly.
lines.zh: : 因为你们不过是比「应当之时」稍微早了一点点在两情相悦地做爱?这很傻。

lines.en: : She’ll be safer because she’ll have stability...and she won’t have to worry about living in an area where people are defecating on the streets.
lines.zh: : 她会更安全,因为她将拥有稳定……而且她不必再担心住在人们当街大便的地方。

lines.en: : I’d never force her to walk away from important memories...that would be insensitive and it is just not the type of person I am.
lines.zh: : 我绝不会逼她抛下重要的回忆……那太残忍,而我根本不是那种人。

lines.en: : The type of person I actually am would subtly convince her that what she wants isn’t what she needs...all while slowly guiding her from the shadows into a safer, healthier life.
lines.zh: : 我真正是的那种人,会不着痕迹地让她相信,她想要的并非她需要的……同时从阴影中缓缓引导她,走向更安全、更健康的生活。

lines.en: : It’s manipulation in the good way. It’s stripping away the things that could potentially hurt her, all while setting her up for success.
lines.zh: : 这是「以好的方式」的操纵。是剥离掉那些可能伤害她的东西,同时为她的成功铺路。

lines.en: : As the new matriarch in her life, it’s my duty to keep an eye on things like that. And, apologies if this dehumanizes you, but you’re a tool I need in order to get that done.
lines.zh: : 作为她人生中的新任女家主,盯着这类事情是我的职责。而且,抱歉这话显得不把你当人——你正是我完成此事所需的工具。

lines.en: : Kind of like how I was a tool to start moving Touka forward as well?
lines.zh: : 有点像我也是推动 Touka 向前的工具?

lines.en: : Exactly.
lines.zh: : 正是。

lines.en: : I look out for my girls.
lines.zh: : 我照顾我的女孩们。

lines.en: : And we both know she’d be better off if she could free herself from that cage of responsibility she was locked in when her mother died.
lines.zh: : 而我们都知道,如果她能挣脱母亲去世时锁住她的那座责任之笼,她会过得更好。

lines.en: : She can’t do it alone...and she won’t accept help from someone who can help her because it will make her feel like she’s failed.
lines.zh: : 她独自做不到……而她也不会接受能帮到她的人的帮助,因为那会让她觉得自己失败了。

lines.en: : But she’ll accept it from someone who can’t.
lines.zh: : 但她会接受一个「帮不上忙」的人的。

lines.en: : At this rate, she won’t accept my aid until her sister falls ill. And by then, it may already be too late.
lines.zh: : 照这个节奏,要等到她妹妹病倒,她才会接受我的援助。而到那时,也许已经太迟。

lines.en: : We can change that if we work together.
lines.zh: : 只要我们联手,就能改变这一切。

lines.en: : I can handle the financials and the motherly bonding-
lines.zh: : 钱和「母亲般的亲情维系」由我来——

lines.en: : And you can be the curtain maintaining the illusion that she’s doing it all on her own.
lines.zh: : 而你可以当那道帷幕,维持「这一切都是她自己做到的」的幻象。

lines.en: : This would be way easier if she’d just accept how shitty her life is.
lines.zh: : 如果她肯直接承认自己的人生有多烂,这一切会容易得多。

lines.en: : I don’t know if she’d have ever made it this far to begin with if she’d done that.
lines.zh: : 我不知道,如果她承认了,她还能不能走到今天这一步。

lines.en: : Sometimes, those less fortunate than us need to refute reality entirely to create a world that feels like it’s worth living in.
lines.zh: : 有时候,那些不如我们幸运的人,必须彻底驳倒现实,才能创造出一个让人觉得值得活下去的世界。

lines.en: : They trick themselves into seeing a light at the end of a tunnel even when everything is dark...and it’s that false chase that keeps them occupied enough to never give up or turn around.
lines.zh: : 他们骗自己相信隧道尽头有光,哪怕四周一片漆黑……正是那场虚假的追逐,让他们忙到永不放弃、永不回头。

lines.en: : When you have nothing, you’re forced to create something.
lines.zh: : 当你一无所有,你就被迫去创造些什么。

lines.en: : What happens when you have everything?
lines.zh: : 那当你拥有了一切呢?

lines.en: : You share it.
lines.zh: : 你分享它。

lines.en: : Tell that to Jeff Bezos or Elon Musk.
lines.zh: : 把这话讲给 Jeff Bezos 或 Elon Musk 听吧。

lines.en: : The only thing I’d tell them is to shove it.
lines.zh: : 我唯一会对他们说的就是「塞回去吧」。

lines.en: : Talk to Chika. Convince her that coming here is the right move.
lines.zh: : 去 和 Chika 谈。说服她,搬来这里才是正确的选择。

lines.en: : I can’t just ask her to move in with me, though. If she finds out Touka gave me this place, it’ll open a whole can of worms and spiral into...terrified jealousy or something. I know her.
lines.zh: : 但我没法直接叫她搬来和我住。她要是知道是 Touka 送我的这地方,会捅出一堆乱子,然后螺旋成……恐慌的嫉妒还是什么。我了解她。

lines.en: : Then just tell her you bought it yourself. Or-
lines.zh: : 那就告诉她,是你自己买的。或者——

lines.en: : Ah!
: I’m a genius!
lines.zh: : 我是个天才!

lines.en: : I’m already aware of that. You don’t have to brag about it.
lines.zh: : 我早就知道了。不必自夸。

lines.en: : The key is quite literally making her think she’s done this on her own.
lines.zh: : 关键就在于,让她以为这一切是她自己争取来的。

lines.en: : So if we frame it as a new, affordable apartment complex with a rate that wouldn't immediately dissuade her, she’ll be able to get out of that god-forsaken section of Kumon-mi once and for all.
lines.zh: : 所以如果我们把它包装成一座新的、租金不至立刻吓退她的平价公寓楼,她就能一劳永逸地搬出 Kumon-mi 那片被神遗弃的街区。

lines.en: : Maybe, but that still doesn’t change the fact that she’s got an extreme emotional attachment to her current place.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。但这仍然改变不了,她对现在住的地方有着极深的情感依恋。

lines.en: : But she has an extreme emotional attachment to you as well. That’s what I’ve been trying to explain all along.
lines.zh: : 可她对你也有着极深的情感依恋。这是我一直试图解释的。

lines.en: : I don’t know, Tsubasa...we can try, but-
lines.zh: : 我不知道,Tsubasa……可以试试,但是——

lines.en: : I’m going to call my daughter. The more bearable one. But think more about what I said.
lines.zh: : 我要给我女儿打电话。比较省心的那个。不过你说的话,再多想想。

lines.en: : You said a lot of things tonight, so if you could give me like one major theme or idea to ponder over while you’re gone, that would be nice.
lines.zh: : 你今晚说了好多东西,所以你离开前,能不能给我一个主题或一个念头,让我咀嚼?

lines.en: : Hmm...I suppose I can pose a question. Does that work?
lines.zh: : 嗯……那我可以出一个问题。行吗?

lines.en: : Sure.
: Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: : What matters more — the livelihood of those you care about...or a life of unparalleled convenience?
lines.zh: : 什么更重要——你在乎之人的生计……还是一种无可比拟的便利人生?

lines.en: : Ooh, and here’s another one — how much work are you willing to put in to help someone resistant to change?
lines.zh: : 哦,这里还有一个——为了帮助一个抗拒改变的人,你愿意投入多少?

lines.en: : Oh! And also-
lines.zh: : 哦!还有——

lines.en: : That’s enough. I’m good with just those two questions. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 够了。这两个问题就够了。谢谢。

lines.en: : One more. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 再来一个。就一个。

lines.en: : Ugh...fine.
lines.zh: : 唉……行吧。

lines.en: : Can you still love someone if they’re always right beside you?
lines.zh: : 如果一个人永远就待在你身边,你还能爱上她吗?

lines.en: Tsubasa leaves before I can tell her I already have an answer to that last question.
lines.zh: Tsubasa 在我来得及告诉她、最后一个问题我早有答案之前,就离开了。

lines.en: It was just someone else who helped me figure it out.
lines.zh: 只是帮我想通它的,是另一个人。

lines.en: Tsubasa’s affection has increased to [tsubasa_love]!
lines.zh: Tsubasa 的好感度提升到了 [tsubasa_love]!
